chunks: And from him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام; and Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī and more than one person, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"If you doubt concerning the Maghrib prayer, then repeat; and if you doubt concerning the Fajr prayer, then repeat."

key_terms.ٱلْفَجْرِ: the Fajr prayer, the dawn salat (prayer)
key_terms.ٱلْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, the sunset salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What should be done if one doubts during the Maghrib or Fajr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding doubt in salat (prayer), specifically for the Maghrib and Fajr prayers. It instructs that when doubt occurs in either of these prayers, the prayer is to be repeated.
